title: Nested process-substitution loses context
falsifier: Fixtures для eval sh <(...) і eval source <(...) не піднімають exception; повертають коректну класифікацію або explicit limitation; жодні інші знахідки не втрачені.
acceptance: Fixtures for both eval sh <(...) and eval source <(...) return a correct classification or explicit limitation without exceptions and without losing unrelated findings.
falsifier_en: Nested process substitutions raise or lose existing findings

title: Command substitution taint is aggregated across unrelated words
falsifier: Pair fixtures: downloaded data only as argv -> no executable-code finding; downloaded code in -c/eval -> finding; labels scoped to exact operand.
acceptance: Paired fixtures produce no executable-code finding when downloaded data is argv only and produce a finding when downloaded code is executed through -c or eval; taint is bound to the exact operand.
falsifier_en: Downloaded data in an unrelated argument taints executable code

title: Here-string misclassified as network redirection
falsifier: cat <<< /dev/tcp/example/80 -> no NETWORK_REDIRECTION; exec 3<>/dev/tcp/example/80 -> positive.
acceptance: The here-string fixture cat <<< /dev/tcp/example/80 produces no NETWORK_REDIRECTION; exec 3<>/dev/tcp/example/80 produces a positive finding.
falsifier_en: A here-string is classified as a network redirect

title: HOME-relative source path with double slash escapes base
falsifier: Fixtures $HOME//.bash_aliases, ~//.bash_aliases, звичайний шлях, symlink, offline root; тільки шлях усередині target home використовується.
acceptance: Test $HOME//.bash_aliases, ~//.bash_aliases, a normal path, a symlink and an offline root; only paths inside the target home may be used.
falsifier_en: HOME-relative double slash or symlink escapes target home

title: Eval-site qualification uses aggregate counts
falsifier: Mixed eval із packaged $(dircolors) + $hook та multiple eval-sites -> PARSE_UNSUPPORTED, ніколи COMPLETED лише через арифметику лічильників.
acceptance: Mixed packaged $(dircolors) and unresolved $hook, including multiple eval sites, produce PARSE_UNSUPPORTED; count arithmetic alone never yields COMPLETED.
falsifier_en: An unresolved eval site is trusted by aggregate counts from another site

title: Relative executable name aliases packaged executable
falsifier: ./prog, ../prog, path/to/prog ніколи не отримують package attestation за basename; тільки точно встановлена канонічна ціль.
acceptance: For ./prog, ../prog and path/to/prog, package attestation never follows from the basename; attest only the exact established canonical target.
falsifier_en: A relative executable is attested by a system executable basename

title: Relay-program denylist is not sound
falsifier: eval of output copied from arbitrary file via dd/other relay -> PARSE_UNSUPPORTED; proof cases with trusted program whose output is not input.
acceptance: Eval of output copied from an arbitrary file through dd and another relay yields PARSE_UNSUPPORTED; include proof cases for a trusted program whose output is independent of its input.
falsifier_en: A trusted relay binary makes arbitrary input appear trustworthy

title: Nested command substitutions inside ${...} discarded
falsifier: Nested ${var:-$(...)} variants recognized or explicit UNPARSED/UNSUPPORTED limitation; no clean acceptance of unexamined executable syntax.
acceptance: Nested ${var:-$(...)} variants are recognized or yield explicit UNPARSED/UNSUPPORTED limitations; unexamined executable syntax never yields a clean acceptance.
falsifier_en: Nested parameter substitutions disappear without a limitation

title: Unbounded recursive quote/parameter parser
falsifier: Nested quoted expansions at 500+ levels give bounded NESTING_LIMIT/UNPARSED_QUOTING, no exception, bounded CPU/RSS and per-file incompleteness.
acceptance: Nested quoted expansions at 500+ levels produce bounded NESTING_LIMIT or UNPARSED_QUOTING without exception, with measured bounded CPU/RSS and per-file incompleteness.
falsifier_en: Deep nested quoting causes recursion failure or unbounded resources

title: hidepid mount visibility incorrectly treated as kernel hiding
falsifier: hidepid=0/1/2 and same/foreign UID fixtures; restricted view -> scope limitation, not HIDDEN_PROCESS.
acceptance: Test hidepid=0/1/2 and same/foreign UID combinations; restricted visibility yields a scope limitation rather than HIDDEN_PROCESS.
falsifier_en: hidepid restrictions are reported as hidden processes

title: Transient sockets create NETLINK_ONLY false alarm
falsifier: Transient UDP churn -> no high-severity hidden-listener finding; stable discrepancy survives independently repeated confirmation.
acceptance: Transient UDP churn causes no high-severity hidden-listener finding; a stable discrepancy must survive independently repeated confirmation.
falsifier_en: A transient socket yields a high-severity hidden-listener alarm

title: Partial ss output used for negative inference
falsifier: Command PARTIAL with truncated empty ss result -> PARTIAL coverage, no absence-based hidden listener; exact command gap recorded.
acceptance: A truncated empty ss result with command status PARTIAL yields PARTIAL coverage, no absence-based hidden-listener conclusion, and an exact command gap record.
falsifier_en: Partial ss output supports an absence-based hidden-listener finding

title: Listener identity collapses address and network family
falsifier: Distinct interface/address/family fixtures remain distinct; exact local endpoint identity used in both views with privacy-safe hashing if stored.
acceptance: Distinct interface, address and family fixtures remain distinct; both views use exact local endpoint identities, with privacy-safe hashing if stored.
falsifier_en: Distinct address or family listeners collapse to a single identity

title: Offline RPM scope limit suppresses unrelated package failure
falsifier: Offline RPM image with unreadable/symlinked repo config -> INCONCLUSIVE; виключаються тільки повністю SKIPPED live-only collector-и.
acceptance: An offline RPM image with unreadable or symlinked repository configuration yields INCONCLUSIVE; exclude only fully SKIPPED live-only collectors.
falsifier_en: A live-only offline exception suppresses unrelated disk-reading failures

title: Unreadable/over-budget dpkg metadata silently dropped
falsifier: Files >4MiB, total >128MiB, >20k records, malformed/permission -> explicit incomplete; records omitted measured separately.
acceptance: Files over 4 MiB, total metadata over 128 MiB, over 20,000 records, malformed data and permission failures produce explicit incomplete coverage with omitted-record counts.
falsifier_en: Unreadable or capped dpkg metadata is silently dropped

title: Offline journal parent symlink crosses root boundary
falsifier: Ancestor symlink under root must be refused; no host-journal leaks; TOCTOU-safe directory handling or skip with limitation.
acceptance: Refuse ancestor symlinks under the image root and demonstrate no host-journal leakage; directory access must be TOCTOU-safe or skipped with an explicit limitation.
falsifier_en: An ancestor symlink lets offline journal reads reach the host

title: AST unparse causes false mutant kills
falsifier: No-op AST roundtrip must not fail suite; mutate only original source span or semantic tests must ignore formatting; mutation tester self-tests.
acceptance: A no-op AST roundtrip passes the suite; mutate only original source spans or make semantic tests formatting-independent; add mutation-tester self-tests.
falsifier_en: A no-op AST roundtrip creates false mutant kills

title: Continuation-line operator modifications omitted from diff mutations
falsifier: Mutation of and→or on changed continuation line always yields eligible mutant; 0 selected on modified semantic code -> FAIL.
acceptance: An and-to-or mutation on a changed continuation line is eligible; zero selected mutations on changed semantic code fails.
falsifier_en: Changed continuation-line operators produce no eligible mutant

title: Mutation budget expiry returns success with NOT_RUN
falsifier: tools/mutate.py --module detectors --budget 0 exits nonzero when any NOT_RUN; test verify --allow-survivors never masquerades as full coverage.
acceptance: A detectors mutation run with zero budget exits nonzero if any required mutant is NOT_RUN; --allow-survivors never represents partial execution as complete coverage.
falsifier_en: A mutation budget expires with NOT_RUN while exit status is successful

title: Package metadata version inconsistent with runtime
falsifier: Runtime version == wheel/SDist metadata == release tag == asset label; single version SSOT tested.
acceptance: Runtime, wheel and sdist metadata, release tag and asset label versions match; test a single source of version truth.
falsifier_en: Runtime, distribution, tag and artifact versions disagree

title: Evidence freshness accepts stale counts and coverage
falsifier: Tamper suite.ran, test_files, coverage, SHA and suite exit -> --check FAIL unless all exact measurements and source digest validated.
acceptance: Individually tamper suite.ran, test_files, coverage, SHA and suite exit; --check fails unless exact measurements and the source digest are validated.
falsifier_en: Stale evidence passes after test counts, coverage or source inputs change

title: Evidence regeneration poisoned by self-referential test
falsifier: Start from stale/red evidence, run controlled regenerate -> green once true implementation gates pass, without manual JSON editing.
acceptance: Starting with stale or red evidence, controlled regeneration becomes green only once actual implementation gates pass, without manual JSON editing.
falsifier_en: Stale committed evidence prevents its own controlled regeneration

title: Line-wide #no mutate hides behavior-changing mutants
falsifier: Only exact proven-equivalent mutation IDs may be waived; 65536→0 mutation must be executed and killed by child stdout capture test.
acceptance: Waive only exact proven-equivalent mutation IDs; execute the 65536-to-0 mutant and kill it with a child-stdout capture test.
falsifier_en: A line-wide waiver hides a non-equivalent mutant

title: Evidence generator success ignores failing ancillary measurements
falsifier: Inject static_analysis.detection_validity.exit=1 with suite.exit=0 -> generator and --check nonzero; all required fields and inputs verified.
acceptance: Inject static_analysis.detection_validity.exit=1 with suite.exit=0; both generator and --check return nonzero, and all required fields and inputs are verified.
falsifier_en: A required ancillary measurement fails while evidence generation succeeds

title: Tag release job permits skipping property tests
falsifier: Tag pipeline installs pinned PBT dependency and fails if PBT absent, skipped or red; same HEAD passes required static, validity, mutation and CodeQL gates.
acceptance: The tag pipeline installs a pinned PBT dependency and fails if required property tests are absent, skipped or failing; required static, validity, mutation and CodeQL gates pass on the same HEAD.
falsifier_en: A release succeeds when required property tests are absent or skipped

title: Published tag trails main by six commits under same runtime version
falsifier: Release identity defined by immutable commit; new version and tag for changed artifacts; no false parity assertion between main and published asset.
acceptance: Bind release identity to an immutable commit; issue a new version and tag for changed artifacts, and make no false parity claim between main and the published asset.
falsifier_en: A release label implies parity with a different source commit

title: GitHub cannot verify SSH tag signature
falsifier: Verify signing public key through independent trusted identity channel; repository GitHub Verified or equivalent trust-root proof; sign release manifest/attestation.
acceptance: Independently verify the signing public key through a trusted identity channel, demonstrate GitHub Verified or equivalent trust-root proof, and sign the release manifest or attestation.
falsifier_en: A release signature has no independently validated signer identity

title: Default branch lacks branch protection/rulesets
falsifier: Main protection/rulesets enforced; direct push rejected, required exact-head CI before merge; solo maintainer does not need separate human approval.
acceptance: Enforce main branch protection or rulesets; verify direct push is rejected and exact-HEAD CI is required before merge. A separate human approval is not required for a solo maintainer.
falsifier_en: A protected-branch claim has no enforceable ruleset evidence

title: Whole-package scheduled job accepts survivors by design
falsifier: Publish complete per-module mutation receipts bound to HEAD and treat unmeasured critical-path mutants as NOT_ESTABLISHED; strict release gate blocks unresolved non-equivalent critical mutants.
acceptance: Publish complete per-module mutation receipts bound to HEAD; report unmeasured critical-path mutants as NOT_ESTABLISHED and block unresolved non-equivalent critical mutants at the strict release gate.
falsifier_en: Scheduled mutation runs accept survivors without adequate qualification

title: Pacman mtree index silently discards incomplete database
falsifier: Malformed, unreadable, >cap pacman mtree fixtures -> PARTIAL, exact missing-record counters; no COMPLETED with incomplete reference set.
acceptance: Malformed, unreadable and over-cap pacman mtree fixtures yield PARTIAL with exact missing-record counters; an incomplete reference set never yields COMPLETED.
falsifier_en: An incomplete pacman mtree database is silently accepted

title: No representative real-malware corpus validation
falsifier: Pre-registered corpus with confirmed labels, provenance, holdout split, environment coverage and per-rule TPR/FNR with confidence intervals.
acceptance: Pre-register a representative corpus with confirmed labels, acquisition provenance, holdout split and environment coverage; report per-rule TPR and FNR with confidence intervals.
falsifier_en: Representative real-world malware detection is claimed without corpus evidence

title: Field false-alarm rate, precision and time to detection unknown
falsifier: Independent benign/malicious host-day corpus: measure FPR per host-day, TPR, PPV by base-rate scenario, detection delay, CIs and subgroup shift.
acceptance: Use an independent benign/malicious host-day corpus to measure FPR per host-day, TPR, PPV by base-rate scenario, detection delay, confidence intervals and subgroup shift.
falsifier_en: Field false-positive, precision or detection delay claims lack representative measurements

title: No measured privileged system-scope host scan
falsifier: Isolated disposable Linux VM privileged scan + command audit proving read-only behavior, bounded subprocess lifecycle, accurate coverage.
acceptance: Run a privileged scan in an isolated disposable Linux VM; audit commands to establish read-only behavior, bounded subprocess lifecycle and accurate coverage.
falsifier_en: Privileged host-scope behavior is asserted only from simulations

title: No real mounted offline image evidence
falsifier: Read-only mounted forensic image with known ground truth and independent image hash, absolute-path containment proof, verified provenance log.
acceptance: Use a read-only mounted forensic image with known ground truth, independent image hash, absolute-path containment proof and verified provenance log.
falsifier_en: Offline-image guarantees are asserted only from constructed fixtures

title: Cross-platform reproducible build not established
falsifier: Independent runners for target matrix produce defined identical bytes or documented platform-specific reproducibility contracts and manifest parity.
acceptance: Compare independent runners across the target matrix: produce defined identical bytes or documented platform-specific reproducibility contracts, and verify manifest parity.
falsifier_en: A same-platform repeated build is called cross-platform reproducible

title: Independent external implementation review not demonstrated
falsifier: Independent challenge audit against frozen commit, seeded defects and evidence receipts; no mandatory separate human sign-off in solo gate.
acceptance: Obtain an independent challenge audit against a frozen commit with seeded defects and evidence receipts; do not require a separate human sign-off in a solo gate.
falsifier_en: An internal review is called independent external review

title: Release assets lack demonstrated signed build attestation and SBOM
falsifier: Artifact SHA256 bound to signed provenance with source commit, builder identity and dependencies; verifiable by external consumer; SBOM published where applicable.
acceptance: Bind artifact SHA-256 to signed externally verifiable provenance containing source commit, builder identity and dependencies; publish an SBOM where applicable.
falsifier_en: Plain release hashes are treated as signed provenance or an SBOM

title: Release evidence has no exact source/test fingerprint
falsifier: Attestation exact HEAD, source tree, test inventory, toolchain and command inputs; any single changed input forces invalidation/re-measurement.
acceptance: Bind a post-commit attestation to exact HEAD, source tree, test inventory, toolchain, command inputs and artifacts; each changed input invalidates evidence and forces remeasurement without self-reference.
falsifier_en: Same-version code or test drift is not detected by release evidence

title: Private vulnerability disclosure configuration not confirmed
falsifier: Confirm active private vulnerability reporting via permitted read-only GitHub configuration/maintainer evidence; publish non-sensitive response policy.
acceptance: Confirm active private vulnerability reporting through permitted read-only configuration or maintainer evidence, and publish a non-sensitive response policy.
falsifier_en: Private disclosure availability is asserted without configuration evidence
